meta.name: Dick Tracy vs. Cueball
meta.description:
Title: Dick Tracy vs. Cueball
Summary: Expensive diamonds are stolen but before the thief can fence them he is strangled by ex-con Cueball, who then takes the gems and continues murdering people he believes are trying to swindle...
Directed by: Gordon Douglas
Actors: Morgan Conway, Anne Jeffreys, Lyle Latell
Production Company: RKO Radio Pictures
Release Date: 18 December 1946 (USA)
Aspect Ratio: 1.37 : 1
   Expensive diamonds are stolen but before the thief can fence them he is strangled by ex-con Cueball, who then takes the gems and continues murdering people he believes are trying to swindle him. Dick Tracy allows his girlfriend Tess to act as a buyer for the gems but his plan backfires when she is captured by the homicidal Cueball.
